title: Emotional Outburst - Unexplained Crying
situation: Mom has been sitting on the couch crying for the last 20 minutes. Nothing happened — we were just watching TV. She can't tell me what's wrong. She just keeps crying and shaking her head. I've never seen her like this and I'm scared something is really wrong.

patient_profile.name: June
behavioral_patterns: sometimes cries when she needs the bathroom
safety_concerns: cannot reliably communicate pain or discomfort
history of UTIs causing behavioral changes

notes: Should NOT demand she explain why she is crying. Should explain that emotional lability in middle-late stage means the brain can trigger crying without a clear cause — or she may be feeling something she cannot articulate. Suggest comfort measures: sit with her, hold her hand, play hymns. Do a basic comfort check (pain, bathroom, hunger, too hot/cold). If crying is new or persistent, recommend contacting her doctor as it could indicate pain, infection, or depression.
